hardware_evidence_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: no hardware capture of this row's cases exists; the default for any row that sets no field
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.CAPTURED: a hardware capture exists but was not acceptance-eligible, so it establishes nothing about PSP behaviour
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.MEASURED: committed, publication-eligible documentation records a real-hardware run of the cases named in evidence_cases; evidence_ref names that document section and evidence_cases must each appear in it verbatim
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.citation_rule: tools/hle_manifest.py grants HARDWARE_MEASURED only from hardware_evidence, and only when MEASURED resolves its evidence_ref through assets/public_source_profile.json and every evidence_case appears in the cited section; status describes the probe source and never grants evidence

tests.measurement_note: The citation covers the three dma-concurrency combinations (concurrent-memcpy-try, concurrent-try-try, concurrent-try-memcpy): 64/64 BUSY from a second-context sceDmacTryMemcpy while the first transfer was pending, and 64/64 zero from a concurrent blocking sceDmacMemcpy, on the qualified PSP-3000-series / 6.61 / ARK-5.1.0 route on 2026-08-27. The invalid-tail-*-* cases are explicitly NOT_MEASURED in the same section (the probe's setup gate SKIPped), and the size-matrix-* cells are not recorded there, so neither is covered by this citation. CASE=dma-cells is a new alignment/overlap probe and remains NOT_RUN. The section names the two APIs rather than the case ids, so every cited historical case id is listed in uncited_cases. No committed machine-checkable run envelope exists for the historical cells; the record is prose in that section.
tests.invariant: concurrency and fully in-bounds copies are measured separately; invalid-tail attempts stop at a safe-boundary SKIP
tests.risk: medium; run concurrency first and isolate invalid-tail launches
tests.reset: return to PSPLINK after each case; a missing record is never PASS
